title: Firefly Wedding TV Anime's Promo Video Reveals Iri's Opening Theme Song
content: The staff for the television anime of Oreko Tachibana 's Firefly Wedding manga announced on Friday that Iri will perform the opening theme song "Period," marking her first song for an anime. The staff began streaming a promotional video that previews Iri's song: The song will launch on November 18.
author: ANN

title: 3 Anime to Watch If You Miss Jujutsu Kaisen
content: Jujutsu Kaisen has become one of the most modern and popular shonen anime series of all time. It has set a caliber that few other anime can actually match, especially in the shonen genre, as it is almost a seinen anime due to its mature themes.
author: ComicBook

title: 7th Be Forever Yamato: Rebel 3199 Film Unveils Main Trailer
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks revealed the main trailer and main visual for Nijiiro no Rinne (Rainbow-Colored Reincarnation), the seventh film in Yamato yo Towa ni: Rebel 3199 ( Star Blazers: Be Forever Yamato - Rebel 3199 ), the latest project in the Space Battleship Yamato remakes, on Friday.
author: ANN

title: Gorō Kanbe's Golian no Junjō na Junai Manga Ends
content: Mag Garden 's Mag Comi platform published the final chapter of Gorō Kanbe 's Golian no Junjō na Junai ( Golian's Pure and Innocent Love ) on August 18. The story follows the cute-looking high-schooler Anzu, who also likes cute things.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Can You Kiss Me First? Series' Teaser Reveals October 19 TV Debut
content: The official website for the live-action series of Yamayade 's Can You Kiss Me First? ( Omae no Hou kara Kiss Shitekure yo ) boys' love manga unveiled a new teaser trailer for the series on Thursday. The teaser reveals the series' October 19 television debut on Fuji TV .
author: ANN

title: The Failure at God School Manga Gets TV Anime
content: A new official website opened on Friday to announce that author Hyuganatsu and artist Modomu Akagawara 's The Failure at God School ( Kami-sama Gakkō no Ochikobore ) manga is getting a television anime.
author: ANN

title: The Apothecary Diaries Author's The Failure at God School Manga Gets Anime Adaptation
content: The Failure at God School supernatural shojo manga by Natsu Hyuga ( The Apothecary Diaries creator) and Modomu Akagawara is officially getting a TV anime adaptation. The story takes place in modern Japan, where people with supernatural abilities can qualify to serve as gods at shrines.
author: Anime Corner

title: Manga 'Gakkou no Ochikobore' Gets TV Anime
content: Production company Bandai Namco Filmworks opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Natsu Hyuuga 's Kamisama Gakkou no Ochikobore ( The Failure at God School ) manga on Friday, revealing a teaser visual (pictured).
